title: Hamiltonian mechanics: phase space and Poisson brackets
summary: The Legendre transformation and Hamilton's equations (from L and from the phase-space action); phase space and Liouville's theorem; Poisson brackets, their algebra, time evolution and conserved quantities; the angular-momentum algebra.

objectives.description: Objectives will be finalised when the unit is prepared; the source material is 8.09 Chapter 1 (Hamiltonian passages, PDF pages 8–9 and 23), the opening of 8.09 Chapter 4, and Tong, Classical Dynamics, Chapter 4.

preparation.description: Read 8.09 Chapter 1, Hamiltonian Mechanics (PDF page 8, Eqs. 1.24–1.28): canonical momenta, Legendre transformation, Hamilton's equations.
Read PDF page 9 (Eqs. 1.30–1.33): when H equals the energy; Lagrangians with linear velocity terms.
Read PDF page 23 (Eqs. 1.81–1.82): Hamilton's equations from the phase-space action.
Read the opening sections of 8.09 Chapter 4 (PDF) on Poisson brackets and canonical variables.
Read Tong, Classical Dynamics, Chapter 4 The Hamiltonian Formulation (reference-only), the sections on Hamilton's equations, Liouville's theorem and Poisson brackets.
